Techtronic Industries Co Ltd Unveils New Cordless Power Tool Line in Hong Kong

HONG KONG, June 19 — Techtronic Industries Co Ltd, a leading machinery company, announced the launch of its latest cordless power tool line at a press event in Hong Kong on Wednesday, aiming to expand its footprint in the fast-growing home improvement and construction markets.

The new product range, called PowerMaxX, includes a series of lightweight drills, impact drivers, and saws powered by advanced lithium-ion batteries. Techtronic Industries Co Ltd said the tools are designed to enhance efficiency for both professional contractors and do-it-yourself enthusiasts, offering longer runtimes and faster charging.

Chief Executive Officer Daniel Fong said, “This launch marks a significant step forward in our commitment to innovation and sustainability. The PowerMaxX series combines high performance with ergonomic design and improved battery technology.” Fong added that the company expects the new line to contribute to a double-digit percentage growth in its hand tools segment over the next fiscal year.

Industry analysts view the launch as a timely move. “Demand for cordless solutions in Asia-Pacific continues to surge, especially as construction rebounds post-pandemic,” said Irene Lau, senior analyst at the Hong Kong Machinery Industry Association. “Techtronic’s focus on lightweight, durable products positions it well against regional competitors.”

The company said the PowerMaxX products will initially be available in Hong Kong and select Southeast Asian markets, with global rollouts planned later in the year. Retail prices are set to start at HK$980.

Techtronic Industries Co Ltd employs more than 25,000 people worldwide and reported annual revenues exceeding US$13 billion last year. Shares were little changed in Wednesday trading.
